Hire real people with real skills.

Delivering brilliant hiring results for leading global brands

Get to know every candidate at scale.

Turn any job into a structured interview built around what truly predicts success. Define the right competencies and questions, with every decision documented and defensible. Deploy direct to your ATS.
Give every candidate the chance to interview in their own words. Structured chat helps you assess everyone consistently, identify stronger candidates and give personalised feedback at scale.
See who stands out and understand why. Explore every score and candidate response with your Talent Intelligence Agent, so you can dig deeper and make confident decisions.
Hire for potential. Not a CV that doesn’t exist yet.
Graduates rarely have the experience to stand out on paper. Sapia.ai assesses the traits and competencies that actually predict future leaders — fairly, and at any volume.
“Sapia.ai has been a valuable tool for improving diversity, accessibility and efficiency in our hiring process.”
– Michael Eizenberg, Head of Qantas Group Talent Acquisition & Benefits

With limited work experience, graduate CVs rarely reveal meaningful differences. Sapia.ai’s chat interview asks five open-ended, competency-based questions — giving every graduate the chance to show potential a CV never could.

One global telco interviewed 3,880 engineering graduates in just 37 days. Sapia.ai’s AI Smart Interviewer scores every candidate consistently, using a rules-based rubric built with your talent team — not a black box, and not “hire people who look like our best guy.”
Sapia.ai integrates with your ATS for a seamless hiring experience.
Ready to uplift your graduate hiring?

Integrated, and personalized to your brand
Everything candidate-facing is personalized to your brand and your voice, so the whole experience is seamless.
